name: Moody AFB
description: Home of the 23rd Wing, Moody AFB projects combat search and rescue and close air support capabilities worldwide. The installation hosts A-10C Thunderbolt II, HC-130J Combat King II, and HH-60W Jolly Green II operations in South Georgia.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. All visitors must obtain a base pass through the Visitor Control Center at the Main Gate.

gates.name: Main Gate (Moody Pkwy)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate on GA-125. Visitor Control Center located to the right of the security checkpoint — do not approach the gate for visitor passes.
gates.address: Bemiss Rd & Davidson Rd (Moody Pkwy), Moody AFB, GA 31699

gates.name: Quiet Pines Gate
gates.notes: 24/7 alternate access on GA-125 north of the Main Gate. Convenient for Hahira and north-corridor commuters.
gates.address: GA-125 & Prewitte St, Moody AFB, GA 31699

gates.name: North Gate
gates.notes: Closed weekends and federal holidays. Best access for North Lowndes County and northern Hahira. 23rd Medical Group is just inside this gate.
gates.address: Bemiss Rd & Mitchell Blvd, Moody AFB, GA 31699

gates.name: South Gate
gates.notes: Outbound traffic only — not available for inbound access. Closed weekends and federal holidays.
gates.address: Bemiss Rd & Radar Site Rd, Moody AFB, GA 31699

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Main Gate)
gates.notes: Walk-in visitor passes and background checks. Closed weekends and federal holidays. REAL ID required. Pre-register visitors via DBIDS/DVES when possible.
gates.address: 9320 Davidson Rd, Bldg 16, Moody AFB, GA 31699

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your Unit Command Support Staff (CSS) normal business hours (Mon-Fri 0730-1630). Attend the newcomers briefing at the Military & Family Readiness Center. Visit Finance in Bldg 105 for travel voucher.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Management Office before arrival. All personnel must visit HMO before signing any off-base lease. Moody Inn offers temporary lodging — book early during PCS season.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: Main Gate and Quiet Pines Gate are open 24/7. North Gate is Mon-Fri 0600-2000. South Gate is outbound only Mon-Fri 1600-1800. Visitor Control Center hours are Mon-Fri 0730-1630. REAL ID required for all visitors.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource and BaseDirectory for relocation support.
